body:
Two low-risk cleanups the final whole-branch review flagged as defer-but-worth-doing:
1. sync.py:~325 comment (added with T-86) claims the future-timestamp clamp "bounds merge-survivor gaming too" — misleading: the name-merge survivor is min(created_at) (EARLIEST wins), so survivorship is gamed with a small/PAST created_at, which a future-only clamp does NOT bound. Correct or delete the comment.
2. T-87 made an empty-body {} PATCH /settings return 200 (leave-everything-unchanged) where it previously 422d. Backward-compatible (no client sends {}), but untested — add a regression test pinning {}->200 no-op so it cannot silently regress.
Also optional (parity): give the unknown_list 422 in sync.py the same details={"row_id": item_id} its sibling missing_list_id/invalid_row rejections carry, so a new item referencing an unknown list can be row-quarantined too.
Files: server/src/shoppinglist_server/sync.py, server/tests/test_account.py, server/tests/test_sync_api.py.
title: Server: two doc/test cleanups from the T-84..T-96 review (merge-survivor comment + {}-PATCH test)
